definition: The acronym POMS means Program Operations Manual System, a set of operational guidelines used as a reference by the Social Security Administration (SSA) to conduct its daily social security activities. The POMS is divided into the following sections:  Records Maintenance  General  Retirement and Survivors Insurance  Disability Insurance  Supplemental Security Income  Health Insurance  Notices, Letters, and Paragraphs  Special Veterans Benefits  Title II Regional Chief Counsel Precedents  Title XVI Regional Chief Counsel Precedents  State and Local Coverage Handbook  Data Exchange Some POMS’ internal data entry and sensitive instructions are not available for public consultation and may be accessed only by authorized SSA personnel.
